title: Regression of #8813 on 18.0.0-next.0: the anonymous public form `/f/:slug` shows English section titles, help text and placeholder in zh-CN, though each section's `name` is translated in the pack and the signed-in form shows Chinese
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23497

Filing gate ①: a user-visible defect, reproduced in a browser.
`reach:` the anonymous `/_console/f/contact-us` and `/_console/f/support` in a zh-CN browser.
Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`session_01BCDqr1DqnQjEh5jA9gGkUG`) from objectstack-ai/hotcrm's v18 test pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2093, finding 13). ⛔ Not a claim. File-at-destination, for triage. If the server's `GET /api/v1/forms/:slug` is the producer, triage moves it.
Reader: the objectui triage seat.
Dedupe: semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui → **#8813** (closed `completed` 2026-09-09): "Public form `/f/:slug` never translates its section labels — … the blocker is `buildSections` dropping `sec.name`". That is this symptom, fixed then, so this card is a regression. Searching objectstack-ai/objectstack gives 21 hits, none on the public form.

## What happens (`@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.0; the console pinned at objectui `1fb1ced`)

Signed out, with the browser locale zh-CN, open `/_console/f/contact-us` (and `/_console/f/support`).
- **Translated:** field labels and options are Chinese (名, 姓, 邮箱, the 行业 options).
- **Not translated:** the section titles read "Tell us about yourself", "About your company", "How can we help?".
- **Help text and placeholder stay English:** "A sales representative will get back to you within one business day.", "Pick the option that best matches your issue.", "Critical issues should also be reported via phone.", "Briefly describe what you are looking for...".

**Why the app side is not the cause (seat-verified in source):**
- objectstack-ai/hotcrm `src/sales/views/lead.view.ts` gives every section a `name` (`tell_us_about_yourself`, `about_your_company`, `how_can_we_help`).
- `src/sales/translations/zh-CN/objects.pipeline.ts` ~196–198 translates exactly those keys (请介绍一下您自己 / 您的公司信息 / 我们能帮您什么？).
- The signed-in New Lead dialog renders its sections in Chinese (联系信息, 线索分类).

Screenshot: [13-zh-cn-public-web-to-lead-form-english-sections.png](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/83746c7a0055cca0f68fc3e72c220d3fce4fa59f/qa/2026-10-13-v18-pass/13-zh-cn-public-web-to-lead-form-english-sections.png).

## Ask

- The anonymous form applies the section translations again, as #8813 made it do. Pin it so it cannot regress.
- Whether a form section's `helpText` and a field's `placeholder` have a translation key at all is the same question as a list column's own label (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2094). If there is none, that half is a spec gap for the owning lane.
